title: Intero Biosystems wants drugmakers to test on mini human intestines, not animals | TechCrunch
summary: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) laid out plans to reduce its reliance on animal testing in drug development, promoting alternatives including organoids, organs-on-chips (small devices that mimic organ functions) and AI-based computational models as potential alternatives.
